text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the partner-facing compatibility plan for the API/SDK v3 change (breaking header format + minor payload rename). Goal: minimal partner churn and Marketplace listing compliance. :spiral_calendar:

sam: timeline idea — 8 week public notice to all partners, 4 week docs + SDK patches, 2 week partner canaries, then gated flip. Is that too long? :thinking:

jordan: 8 weeks aligns with product roadmaps. also want coordinated joint-announcement window for marketplace + 2 major HW partners. prefer announcement on a Tue to avoid weekend outages.

alex: heads-up — some SI integrators bundle the SDK into installers that are monthly release-cycled. we should offer a grace period and a compatibility shim for 3 months.

maria: agreed. propose:
- week 0: partner heads-up email + partner portal draft
- week 2: SDK patches + migration guide publish (py, js, go)
- week 4–6: 5 partner canaries (1 marketplace vendor, 2 HW OEMs, 2 SIs)
- week 8: soft-deprecation (warning headers)
- week 12: enforced removal (hard error)

katie: legal/contract ask — need to send language for marketplace T&Cs change. @lee can you draft a short addendum for partner agreements?

lee: on it. will push a 1-paragraph addendum and an FAQ for common contract Qs. need to confirm whether this triggers any SLA adjustments.

sam: for the SDK changes, here's the recommended migration snippet (will add to docs):
```
# old header
curl -H "Authorization: Redwood token-xxxxx" https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
# new header
curl -H "x-rw-api-key: rw-xxxx" -H "x-rw-version: 3" https://api.redwood.ai/v3/generate
```

maria: nice. also we should publish a lightweight test harness partners can run against their integrations. sample command:
```
# quick compat test (bash)
python tools/compat_check.py --endpoint https://partner.example.com/callback --api-key rw-test --version 3
```

deploy-bot: NOTE — marketplace listings have a weekly deployment blackout on Sundays 02:00-06:00 UTC. schedule announcements outside that window.

alex: for HW partners, thermal/latency regressions are a real risk when switching kernels. ask infra to produce perf delta reports for top 3 models before canary. @sam can you own that?

sam: yep. I'll run perf + quantization compatibility checks and share a short report. aiming to have results by week 3.

jordan: communications plan: draft partner notice copy (2 variants: Marketplace vendors, OEM/SI). want to include migration timeline, code samples, rollback options, and a support SLA for canary partners. I'll iterate on the copy and share by EOD Fri.

katie: Ops ask — add a dedicated support rotation for the 2-week canary window. need 24/7 oncall for that period. who volunteers? :raising_hand:

maria: i'll coordinate volunteers with eng-oncall and partner success.

lee: also recommend a liability note for OEMs that do binary bundling — we should require a signed compatibility attestation for partners that embed our runtime.

alex: what about marketplace freeze? some partners can't change their listings on short notice because of marketplace review times. propose we set a hard deadline for partners to submit updated SDK bundles 3 weeks before enforced removal.

maria: good catch — add that to partner email.

sam: checklist for release engineering:
- publish v3 SDKs (py/js/go)
- add deprecation header warning on v2 responses
- enable feature-flag for canary partners (by partner-id)
- run perf regression suite across GPUs and quant levels

maria: Can each owner drop their short bullet status in this thread by Mon? I'll compile into the partner-facing calendar and send the notice.

jordan: Ack — I'll have draft notices and announcement calendar.

lee: Ack — draft legal addendum by Mon.

sam: Ack — perf report and SDK PRs by Mon.

katie: Ack — will coordinate oncall schedule.

maria: Thanks team. If we get partner sign-off early, we can shorten canary window. otherwise proceed with the conservative timeline. :thumbsup:
